name: Sheba
summary: A Benjamite who blew a trumpet and led Israel away from King David after Absalom's revolt. Joab chased him to the city of Abel, where the people cut off his head.

key_moments.title: Calls Israel to Rebel
key_moments.description: Sheba blew a trumpet and cried that Israel had no part in David, and the men of Israel followed him. Only the men of Judah stayed with their king.

key_moments.title: Beheaded in Abel
key_moments.description: Joab besieged the city of Abel where Sheba was, and a wise woman called to Joab from the wall. She went to the people, and they cut off Sheba's head and threw it out to Joab, who then left the city.
